Fusun said she felt like we were still a half baked solution compared to both ConnectWise, and their former use of Tigerpaw. Said she wanted to reconnect when we had more features, but wasn't able to provide me with exactly what those features were. But these are some of the items they called out during our demo needing.

Good persona for a client, but we don't have a Kaseya VSA integration and ConnectWise does. They know they need to switch off on prem VSA before switching PSA's, since no one else integrates. It's just such a large undertaking that they would need to tackle first as they can't do both migrations at the same time. A reason was required above so selected co-managed since we discussed that as well, but not a dealbreaker.
